# Bootstrap

Read the relevant specifications before editing.

Implement only the project foundation.

Set up:

- TypeScript;
- Express HTTP application;
- scripts for dev/build/start/test/lint/typecheck as appropriate;
- `node:test` integration test runner;
- Supertest or an equivalent HTTP test client;
- formatting/linting;
- initial directories.

Do not implement database, CSV import, business rule, or final API behavior.

Validate with available checks.

Record actual changes and validation in `docs/ai/development-log.md`.
